name: agent-teams
description: AgentTeams 多智能体协作：当前会话成为队长，组建可续跑的成员团队，把目标拆成依赖任务 DAG，经成员邮箱直连协作，由指令式调度推进，并提供只读团队面板。

description_i18n.en: AgentTeams multi-agent collaboration: the current session becomes a captain, assembles continuable members, splits a goal into a dependency task DAG, coordinates via member mailboxes with directive scheduling, and exposes a read-only team panel.
description_i18n.zh-CN: AgentTeams 多智能体协作：当前会话成为队长，组建可续跑的成员团队，把目标拆成依赖任务 DAG，经成员邮箱直连协作，由指令式调度推进，并提供只读团队面板。

maxMembers.title: Maximum members per team
maxMembers.description: Upper bound of team roster size (captain excluded).

maxReassignRounds.title: Maximum reassign rounds per task
maxReassignRounds.description: Upper bound of how many times a single task can be reassigned before the captain must stop and report. Reassigning beyond this is refused.

panelEnabled.title: Enable read-only team panel
panelEnabled.description: Serve a localhost read-only panel from the MCP server process.

inheritCaptainModel.title: Inherit captain model for members
inheritCaptainModel.description: Off (default): use the configured AgentTeams member model, then the general-purpose subagent model; refuse to spawn if neither is configured. On: members without a dedicated model inherit the captain model.
